runtime_contract_lineage_repair.description: Exact Unified-Registry -> Hash-Lineage -> runtime-contract repair scope. It permits only the canonical contract registry, its active runtime projection, strict hash/interface guards, the formal Evidence hash-precache chain, the bounded V21.5 operating-evidence cross-validation bridge, the exact formal-signal Artifact materialization edge, Product Signal Admission as the mandatory business gate before Agent1, the exact admission-qualified formal-signal -> Agent1 handoff inside the existing single worker, deterministic Agent1 projection de-duplication under the unchanged 22k item budget, Agent3 exact-path semantic repair, completed-contract projection, structured current-state failure projection, the frontend canonical-product Hash View repair, and the frozen Task Evidence canonical-history repair. Competition Evidence and Task Evidence are derived only from canonical product facts within the active history epoch. Task Evidence may read only the task-bounded current-epoch canonical history through the registered single-row/single-product bridge; system_product_snapshots_v14 is forbidden as an active Task Evidence authority. Task dataVersion and task creation time remain hard freeze boundaries, old task-detail materializations may be invalidated only by source-version change and rebuilt from task_status, and the two-observation execution gate remains unchanged. No repair may force-rebuild canonical snapshots, scan or retain complete multi-product historical payloads, create a second product fact root, alter Agent/provider policy, broaden Task admission, or weaken fail-closed execution. Runtime membership may change only when the added/removed file is explicitly allowlisted or owned by an explicitly allowed registry module. All unrelated production files, modules, nodes and special hashes remain fail-closed.
